subject: Startups
title: Follow-On Strategy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Follow-On Strategy.

hook.text: Smart VCs don't invest once and walk away. They reserve cash to double down on their best-performing startups.

buildup.text: This is called follow-on investing: putting more money into winners in later rounds to maintain or grow your stake.

discovery.text: A good rule: reserve 50% of the fund for follow-ons. Your best companies need your biggest checks.

twist.text: The trap: VCs sometimes follow on into failing companies too, hoping to rescue a bad bet. Good money after bad.

climax.text: Follow-on discipline separates great VCs from good ones. Double down on winners, let losers go.

punchline.text: Water the flowers. Pull the weeds. Simple but hard.

quiz.question: What is follow-on investing in VC?
options: Putting more money into existing portfolio winners
